source_revision: The commit containing this evidence directory

minio.build: go install github.com/minio/minio@v0.0.0-20250907161309-07c3a429bfed; built locally from pinned official source, not a release binary

environment.proxy_scope: HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY removed case-insensitively from the command subprocess environment only; global configuration unchanged

scope: Closed-loop local microbenchmark over real TCP/mTLS with PostgreSQL; client and services share a Go test process. No external LLM/business target, open-loop offered load, production capacity, paired B1-B4 benefit or complete M1 exit established.
development_note: First 20-sample pilot correctly rejected an invalid one-hour gateway TTL configured by the new harness. The harness now uses the production default. A separate debug run passed, then warmup was changed to use measurement concurrency so pool expansion is not mixed into measured samples. This retained run used frozen final benchmark/validator sources, a fresh isolated cluster, three repetitions, and no assertion or measurement retry. Existing production sources were unchanged.
